⚖️ Indonesian Legal Bench Dataset (ID_Legal_Bench)
	

This repository contains the ID_Legal_Bench dataset, a high-fidelity benchmark specifically designed to evaluate the structured answering process and semantic accuracy of legal AI models in the Indonesian jurisdiction. 🏛️
